decisions.reason: The one-time remediation method for misplaced site content does not change the future-location expansion capability or template strategy.
The client requests copying site content between profiles but does not change the required master domain or domain-to-website mapping.
Copying content into the correct profile is compatible with, and does not alter, the requirement that each location have its own website.
The requested content-copy remediation does not merge accounts or change the separate-account model or account-bound configuration.
The source decision does not change the location selector, selectable locations, or visitor-routing behavior.
The instruction concerns moving existing site content to another profile, not changing the visual reference, layout, or navigation design.
Copying content between profiles does not change the mobile-friendly design requirement.
The source does not change the brand name, logo, palette, positioning, or cross-location branding rules.
The requested profile remediation does not modify the package catalog or pricing-consistency requirement.
The source specifies how to remediate profile placement but does not add, remove, or revise homepage content requirements.
The content-copy request does not change where bookings occur, account-level booking isolation, or Ridgehaven booking activation.
The remediation method does not alter the requirement to keep the legacy site available or the required master-site linkage.
